definitions.explanation: A spirit, often of a dead person, that brings harm or misfortune to the living. Common in horror stories and in talk of exorcism.

examples.japanese: {悪霊|あくりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}い{払|はら}う→追い払う：06347_oiharau⟧。
examples.english: To drive out an evil spirit.
They say there is an evil spirit in this house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{神父|しんぷ}→神父：17961_shinpu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少女|しょうじょ}→少女：03233_shoujo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{取|と}りついた{悪霊|あくりょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{戦|たたか}う→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧。
examples.english: In the film, a priest battles the evil spirit possessing a young girl.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悪霊|あくりょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{取|と}りつかれる: to be possessed by an evil spirit
- {悪霊|あくりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ / ⟦{祓|はら}う→祓う：13897_harau⟧: to exorcise an evil spirit
- {悪霊|あくりょう}⟦{退散|たいさん}→退散：14402_taisan⟧: 'begone, evil spirits!' (a set chant, often joking)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{怨霊|おんりょう}→怨霊：13454_onryou⟧: vengeful ghost of someone who died with a grudge
- ⟦{幽霊|ゆうれい}→幽霊：10648_yuurei⟧: ghost (neutral, not necessarily harmful)
- ⟦{悪魔|あくま}→悪魔：01768_akuma⟧: devil, demon (Christian or general sense, not a dead person's spirit)
